$comment: Dated aliases of sf-chat-window for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard §16 item 20). The 0.3 window raised each port intent as chat-port:<name> and each window capability as chat-window:<name>, with {request_id, ...payload}; 1.0 raises one event per verb, sf-chat-window-<verb> {request-id, intent, kind, payload} (vocabulary 1.1.5 §5, §5.1), so every row is split, sent only when the detail's intent is the one the old name stood for (when, since a verb carries several old names), and the element adapter (sfAliasAdapters) makes its 0.3 detail. sf-chat-window-answer became the fact settled.

aliases.note: the port intent conversation.open: open {kind: conversation} {request-id, intent, payload}; the 0.3 detail {request_id, ...payload} is made by the element adapter (sfAliasAdapters) for this intent only
the port intent history.older: load-more {kind: history} {request-id, intent, payload}; the 0.3 detail {request_id, ...payload} is made by the element adapter (sfAliasAdapters) for this intent only
